## Phase 2: greedy V-cycles (hard, 1000 boards, baseline 84.3%)

Each cycle re-encodes the current board and regenerates from the restart level at temperature 0. *Checker-gated* cycles only boards the Sudoku checker rejects. *Residual-gated* cycles only the boards whose level-local residual is in the top q (no checker, no solution). Extra NFE is the mean per board over all cycled boards, summed over cycles (gating would lower it).

## Prompted tasks: soft decisions and guidance, first run (tuning half A, report half B)

One greedy pass. *Soft*: the next level and the decoder read the posterior-mean code vector under softmax(logits / Ts) at the listed levels (all, all but the last, or the coarse levels). *cfg ramp s*: the released guidance schedule (generate(cfg_scale=s)); *cfg coarse/fine w*: constant weight on the coarse or fine levels only. NFE counts a guided level as 2; *Positions*: generator token positions relative to the single pass (prompt cached). Documents are split at random into halves; stage 2 combines the arms that were best on half A. Differences on half B: paired bootstrap over documents.

## Pairwise preference by a local LLM judge

Each item pairs two texts made from the same single-pass sample (LM1B) or for the same source (XSum, WMT14). The judge sees both orders; an item's preference for A is the mean over the orders of P(A's letter) / (P(A) + P(B)) from its next-token probabilities. CIs: bootstrap over items. *Order agreement*: share of items on which the judge picks the same text in both orders.

| Task | A | B | Items | Mean preference for A [95% CI] | Share preferring A [95% CI] | Order agreement | Judge |

## WMT14: V-cycles after a soft pass

*soft*: soft decisions at every level, Ts = 1. *soft + vcycle m c*: the soft pass's output is re-encoded (canonical form), the encoder's levels < m are kept, and the other levels are regenerated with soft decisions, c times. *soft + no-restrict m*: the soft pass's own chosen codes are kept below m instead (no re-encoding). *soft draft, hard vcycle*: the same cycle with hard regeneration. *vcycle m c*: the hard V-cycle from the hard single pass, as in the section on prompted tasks above. Differences: paired bootstrap over sentences. *Changed*: share of sentences whose output differs from the previous cycle's.

## WMT14: minimum-Bayes-risk decoding, our run

K candidates per source (11 evaluations each); the pick is the candidate with the highest mean utility against the others (sentence chrF or sentence BLEU, sacreBLEU). *sampled*: the released sampler at temperature tau. *sampled coarse + soft*: levels 0–4 sampled at tau, the other levels greedy with soft decisions (Ts = 1). The NCM paper reports 25.2 BLEU for K = 12 without stating the utility, the temperature or the casing; the public NCM code has no MBR script, so this recipe is ours. *Single candidate*: mean corpus BLEU of one candidate. *Oracle*: the candidate with the best sentence chrF against the reference. Differences: paired bootstrap over sentences against the greedy single pass and the greedy soft pass.

### newstest2013 (development) (3000 sentences)
